provider: NLnet / Restack Fund - the grant an unaffiliated individual can actually hold

free_tier.stated: EUR 5,000-50,000 for a first grant, and storage is a claimable project expense rather than a byte allocation. Next deadline 3 November 2026 12:00 CET; deadlines fall on the 3rd of every odd month.

chaining: Explicitly individual-eligible: 'In principle anyone can apply: individuals, research organisations, non-profits, public institutions, companies of any size and type'. A second grant can follow a first. Funds open at proposal time: Restack, CodeSupply, Other/open call.
limits_note: Must be technical development, released under an open licence, and no AI-generated proposals ('We are not interested in AI-generated projects or proposals'). EU-supported funds require a European dimension - a non-EU applicant must pick a fund whose eligibility section does not impose it. Money arrives against a contract, so a bank account and a legal entity are needed.
reliability_note: Realistic size: a EUR 50k grant buys roughly 12-25 TB-months at Hetzner-class pricing, or funds an engineer - it does not buy 20 TB for five years. Treat grants as funding the software around the storage, not the storage.
